listing.name: Mega Man Legends — MegaManLegendsRecomp (VuloB1)
listing.summary: Experimental project. The project describes native enhancements and a terrain-edge white-line defect. An HD pack is not included, and a complete campaign has not been established. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA PlayStation Mega Man Legends disc. This guide does not specify the exact required serial number or revision; check this game’s game.toml and DISC requirements rather than another game’s settings.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Initialize the pinned submodules and regenerate gameC from your own Mega Man Legends disc with the documented psxrecomp_cli.py generate command. Build psx-runtime with CMake and Ninja. Keep generated code private; publishing it is not part of setup. The project’s release and launcher packages have not been inspected or confirmed by this guide.

warnings: The project describes native enhancements and a terrain-edge white-line defect. An HD pack is not included, and a complete campaign has not been established.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
